title: Library / Apps Screen
purpose: Application catalog, repository installer, and authentication for third-party apps
states: open-catalog - showing built-in catalog of apps
open-custom - showing repo URL installation form
toasts - notifications shown as corner toasts when closed
acceptance: shall display as modal overlay with backdrop
shall show three sections: Library, Repository, Sign In
shall display app cards with icon, title, and Install button
shall show installation progress for in-flight installs
shall display success/error notices for completed installs
shall show corner toasts when screen is closed
shall support installing from GitHub repo URL
shall support GitHub authentication via token
shall close on backdrop click or close button
